description: Structured Global Memory v1 — frozen authoritative rules. Converted from analysis/failure_analysis_t0_t7_t9.md + resources/libero/memory/MEMORY.md. Every rule carries a source citation; rules without experimental backing were NOT added. Phase model: P_init -> P_look -> P_transport -> P_grasp -> P_place -> P_verify (derived from cumulative tool counts).

phases.hint: perceiving / localizing — resolve a target xyz, then act. Never loop perception.

rules.expected_result: planner 在 2 次调用内 commit 一个目标 xyz 并执行动作（move_to / pi0_pick / pi0_doubled）
rules.failure_pattern: F1 感知循环：连续感知无动作 >=10（t9 fail max_redundant 16-22）
rules.recovery: Commit now: pick one target xyz from what you already saw. The very next tool call must be an action primitive (move_to / pi0_pick / pi0_doubled) — do not sample again.
rules.source: failure_analysis_t0_t7_t9.md F1 (§1 t9 fail max_redundant 16-22; §2 t9 失败链 6×back_project+3×segment→pi0_pick×4)

phases.hint: travelling to the target — one deliberate approach, then pick.

rules.expected_result: planner 重新定位一次后一次性移动到位，进入 P_grasp
rules.failure_pattern: F2 重定位循环：move_to >=7（t7 fail move_to×7-10 / t0 fail move_to×17）
rules.recovery: Stop repositioning. Re-localize the target once (one back_project), then ONE deliberate move_to straight to it, then pick. Repeated travel burns turns (F2).
rules.source: failure_analysis_t0_t7_t9.md F2 (§1 t7 fail move_to×7-10 / t0 fail move_to×17; §2 t7 失败链 6×back_project→move_to×10)

phases.hint: grasping — fix pre-grasp (wrist pitch / clearance), retry at most twice.

rules.expected_result: planner 检查 pre-grasp（wrist pitch / clearance）后一次成功，或诚实上报停止循环
rules.failure_pattern: F3 执行精度重试：pi0_pick >=3（t9 fail pi0_pick×2-4）
rules.recovery: Repeated pi0_pick means the pre-grasp is wrong. Check wrist pitch / clearance once, retry at most once more, then if still failing report honestly via finish — do not loop.

phases.hint: placing — t9: prefer pi0_doubled double-stage placement; cap placement retries.

rules.trigger: t9 进入 P_place 且尚未使用 pi0_doubled（单次 release 精度不足）
rules.expected_result: planner 用 pi0_doubled 双段放置完成最终放置
rules.failure_pattern: t9 成功靠双段放置补精度；单次 release 精度不足（H2 强支持）
rules.recovery: t9 placement precision: use pi0_doubled (double-stage placement) for the final placement instead of a single release — the successful t9 chain is segment→back_project→move_to→pi0_pick→set_gripper→pi0_doubled.

phases.hint: confirm final placement, then call finish — do not re-open perception.

rules.trigger: 进入 P_verify（已完成两次放置）
rules.expected_result: planner 检查最终状态并 call finish(status='success')
rules.failure_pattern: H1 收敛：放置完成后仍回感知/重放（t0 执行后 recovery 循环）
rules.recovery: Placement is done. Check the last view_driver_state for episode_terminated / task-language satisfied; if satisfied call finish(status='success') now — do not re-open perception or re-place.

phases.hint: any phase — over-reading memory, placement-retry loops and budget exhaustion are phase-independent failure modes.

rules.expected_result: planner 确认最终放置一次后诚实 finish，不再重试
rules.failure_pattern: F3 放置重试：pi0_doubled >=3（t0 fail pi0_doubled×12）
rules.recovery: Placement is looping (pi0_doubled >= 3). Confirm the last placement once, then call finish honestly — repeated placement retries waste the turn budget.

rules.expected_result: planner 停止读 memory，用当前知识行动
rules.failure_pattern: F4 过度阅读：read_text_file >=10（t0 fail 20+ reads）
rules.recovery: Stop reading memory files — you have enough. Act now with current knowledge; re-reading is a known failure loop (F4).

rules.trigger: 预算将尽（剩余 <= 5 回合）
rules.expected_result: planner 做一次决定性尝试；任务语言无法满足则诚实 finish，不烧光剩余回合
rules.failure_pattern: F2/F3/F5 失败终点 max_turns / infra_timeout
rules.recovery: Budget nearly exhausted. Make one final decisive attempt; if the task language is not satisfiable, call finish honestly — do not burn the remaining turns.
rules.source: failure_analysis_t0_t7_t9.md §1 失败终点 max_turns / infra_timeout
